thread:
Maya (sec-eng): Heads-up: eu-keystore rotation planned 2026-10-12 09:00 UTC. We need to ensure DSAR deletions & retention-exception logic survive rotation.
Ethan (eng-infra): We should gate rotation on: no queued deletions referencing retiring key-version OR successful rewrap of <500 objects.
Lina (platform-sre): Worker will do: (1) fetch deletion_request, (2) verify hold=false, (3) decrypt, (4) sign receipt, (5) upload receipt -> delete. Add recheck for hold between steps 2 and 4.
Ben (legal): Receipt fields must include deletion_id, resource_hash (sha256), actor (service or person), timestamp, key_id, key_version, and optional hold_id. Must be signed (JWS) and stored immutable.
kmsbot: Advisory: ensure KMS sign API available for our HSM-backed signer before rotation.
Maya (sec-eng): RBAC: create ephemeral role `dsar-runner` with kms:Decrypt conditioned on tag dsar=true and aws:PrincipalArn equals role ARN. No broad decrypt.
Ethan (eng-infra): I'll run pre-rotation SQL to find pending jobs that cite the retiring version. If rows > 0 and count < 500 -> rewrap tool. Else delay rotation.
Lina (platform-sre): Also add abort receipt type when hold discovered mid-run, include reason and snapshot of hold metadata.
oncall (ops): I'll be oncall. If deletion fails with DecryptFailed, ping @oncall with id.
Ben (legal): Also note: if a retention-exception exists, deletion must not proceed and we need retention-exception id in audit blob.
Maya (sec-eng): Action items: Ethan post SQL results + rewrap plan; Lina post updated worker flow and sample JWS; Ben confirm hold metadata fields by EOD. React :thumbsup: when claimed.
Ethan (eng-infra): :thumbsup: will post results morning.
